outcome: prevalence of Mistreatment in Maternity Care (MMC)
instrumental delivery or caesarean unregistered in clinical records or performed with non-evidence-based clinical indication (UNREG/N-EB)
no maternal position choice during labor and delivery
no freedom to drink freely during labor and delivery
cohort: A total of 847 women participated in the study after being contacted by consecutive recruitment.
finding: The prevalence of Mistreatment in Maternity Care indicators (MMCi) ranged from 4.3% for unregistered instrumental delivery or caesarean sections to 48.1% for perception of inadequate attention, with six indicators exceeding 40%.
mod_finding: The prevalence of MMCi was 4.3% for instrumental delivery or caesarean unregistered in clinical records or performed with non-evidence-based clinical indication.
cross-section timing: Data was collected around the time of childbirth, focusing on obstetric practices and childbirth characteristics.
